title: Per-account trade actions belong at the RiskManager level: a live-review/desk mandate or action scoped to ONE account must apply only to that account's leg, enforced per account in RiskManager (approve_amend / per-account apply), never by strategy- or package-level scoping
note: Operator 2026-11-09 ~20:20Z (chat, verbatim): "Yes, single -account mandates need to be implemented at the risk manager level, not the strategy level". FINDING (lane B2-SOL-BE-STOP, session_01AFoLuLMZfK67mZozcreUfq, 20:15Z): src/runtime/ltr_auto_mandate.py and scripts/ops/live_review_apply.py filter legs only by account_scope; package_scope.accounts is decorative and never read. So a package-scoped mandate on a multi-account package (e.g. pkg-50f5eed272f64197 on breakout_2 + tradeify_1 + velotrade_1) would apply to EVERY account, and an account_scope mandate matches any package naming that account. Today's workaround: a directed action on breakout_2 only. BUILD (post-reset unless live money needs it sooner): a mandate/action carries an account set; RiskManager's per-account approve step refuses any leg whose account is outside it (consistent with 'the review works at the PACKAGE level and never does per-account risk management': the review stays package-level, the per-account fence lives in RiskManager); tests with a 3-account package; make package_scope.accounts either enforced there or removed. (Manager 2026-11-09a) 2026-11-09 20:19Z SECOND DEFECT, same case: directed action DA-20261109T201558Z-tighten_sl-f367d2 (breakout_2:prop-manual-ed6dc04db93b, tighten_sl 87.64) refused at dry-run with 'package pkg-50f5eed272f64197 not open' (live_review_apply.run requires order_packages.status=='open'), while /api/bot/prop/tickets shows that ticket status=filled and /api/bot/prop/status open_risk lists it open (fill 231, qty 6.82, sl 89.10). So the prop ticket outlives its order package and NO automated route can amend that prop leg: the apply path keys on the package, not the ticket. Fallback today: operator sets the stop by hand. The fix belongs in this row's build (the per-account action targets the account's own leg/ticket). (Manager 2026-11-09a) 2026-11-09 ~20:30Z: the operator moved breakout_2's SOL short stop BY HAND (ticket prop-manual-ed6dc04db93b, fill 231; intended ~87.64 breakeven, from 89.10). The journal still reads sl 89.1. The operator asked that 'the app look and update' rather than send a manual {kind: amend}. GAP: (a) the app reads a stop only during an amend attempt or a drill; there is no read-and-report request; (b) phone_trail human_moved with a real sl_read only sets human_hold and never writes the journal. Operator popup: 'After the reset'. Build with this row: human_moved carrying a read value ingests the amend (source phone_read_human); add a read-now request per ticket; tests (read -> journal follows; unread -> nothing; tighter and looser both recorded truthfully). Interim: journal overstates breakout_2 risk (safe side); the trail only tightens. (Manager 2026-11-09a) 2026-11-10 10:40Z operator, verbatim: 'in order to try and save the breakout 2 account, I'm manually updating the sl a little more aggressively to lock in r and build back the cushion so we have more leeway in the next trade - updated now to 85.5'. breakout_2 SOL short prop-manual-ed6dc04db93b, entry 87.64, qty 6.82. The SL is now 85.5 by hand (second hand move; first was the breakeven tighten 11-09). Our record (GET /api/bot/prop/status 10:36Z) STILL shows sl 89.1 (ticket_sl 89.10464), open loss-to-stop $9.96. Real: locked gain (87.64-85.5)*6.82 = $14.59 gross, about +1.47R. Equity 4882.31, distance to the 4850 static floor $32.31 (includes unrealized). Consequences until the post-reset build: (a) risk/headroom math overstates this ticket's open risk by about $24.5 (conservative, not dangerous); (b) phone_trail's pre-click check reads the terminal stop, sees it differs, reports human_moved, sets human_hold, and never overrides the operator; the trail stays held until the human level is recorded via note_human_amend. Build (post-reset, already on this row): the app reads the hand-moved stop and records it (note_human_amend) so the journal, risk and trail resume from 85.5. 2026-11-10 ~15:50Z: operator hand-moved the breakout_2 SOL stop again, 85.5 -> 82.5 (third hand move on prop-manual-ed6dc04db93b). The journal still says 89.1. Another case for the app reading and recording hand-moved stops. 2026-11-10 15:45Z: new trend_donchian_eth_4h ETH short (entry 2011.36, SL 2079.50, TP 1812.24, risk $10) was EMITTED on tradeify_1 and velotrade_1 and REFUSED on breakout_2 by the server risk gate: 'cushion_unknown (risk at stop 9.54; the snapshot carries no unrealized P&L, so open positions cannot be marked to their stops)'. The gate marks the open SOL to the JOURNAL stop (89.1), but the real hand-set stop is 82.5 (locks about +$35). Recording hand-moved stops would let the gate see a positive locked cushion. The refusal is conservative and fails closed, which matches the operator's 'build back the cushion first' intent today. Post-reset: feed the hand-recorded stop and unrealized P&L into the breakout_2 cushion calc. [2026-11-12 09:35Z AM-TRADING] Its breakout_2 cushion half (feed hand-moved stops + unrealized into the cushion) is PHONE-LIVE-ACCOUNT-FEED's done test; its per-account RiskManager half goes with the PROP-VM-ACTIONS spawn (CAP-PROP-VM-CLOSE) once that lane exists.
